In his inaugural address, President Trump promised to lower costs for  Americans. Hours later, he raised them by revoking a Biden EO that lowered drug costs for Medicare & Medicaid patients.

Everyday Americans deserve better.

Today, I shared my own story and spoke out against the Born Alive Survivors Protection Act on the House floor.

If Republicans actually cared about mothers and families - they wouldn’t  criminalize doctors for keeping patients safe OR take away women’s reproductive freedom. https://t.co/1ECVfS0zPJ

Alongside the sweeping January 6 pardons, @POTUS pardoned 23 individuals who were prosecuted under federal law for attacking and harassing patients & staff in abortion clinics across the country last week.

He called them “peaceful protesters.” Where is his focus on safety now?

To add insult to injury, the Dept. of Justice will no longer prosecute similar cases.

Decisions like this from the Trump administration make it easier to target medical professionals and patients, decreasing public safety and safe health care options.

Next up, Whip Clark & I are convening a roundtable with health care professionals and patients to discuss how important it is that we lower health care and drug costs for Americans.

I know all too well that high health care costs and bills can be devastating. https://t.co/4i9Iogww3i

Federal funds allow hospitals like UCSF Benioff to stretch their funds as far as possible to provide for patients and ensure people have access to affordable drugs.

Thank you for keeping your communities healthy, @UCSFBenioffOAK!

Medicaid and CHIP are on the chopping block under the Republican plan to give the uber wealthy record tax breaks.

 In CA-12, nearly 150,000 of my constituents risk losing coverage. 

Over 40,000 of them are children under the age of 19 and almost 20,000 are seniors.
As the Congresswoman from #CA12, I will always fight to protect Medicaid and lift working people, the elderly, and those with special needs who often are left behind in policy conversations.

I want to make myself clear: I am going to OPPOSE the Republican budget that makes deep cuts to Medicare, Medicaid, and Social Security.  I am not going let them bully us into a vote that dismisses the values of CA-12 and hurts working families. Period, full stop. 

https://t.co/0PiU2mUxcZ

🚨 "I will forcefully vote NO on the Republicans' Budget Resolution this week, I refuse to support a budget that cuts critical health care, education, and nutrition programs, while increasing tax cuts for the wealthiest." 🚨

Read my full statement here:: https://t.co/YfDLVtwYae https://t.co/Fy0stxXTPI

Today, I joined Leader @repjeffries & our Democratic colleagues to highlight the GOP budget plan that puts Medicaid, Medicare, and Social Security on the chopping block in exchange for tax breaks for the rich. 

It's unfair, and I refuse to vote for it. https://t.co/UT5WVJG1sS

I am voting NO on the Republican Budget proposal that would take away Medicare and SNAP for over 200,000 working people in CA-12.

It’s deeply cruel to take away from these critical programs that help everyday Americans get by and give a huge tax break back to billionaires.

House Republicans' vast cuts in the federal workforce are having deep impacts on Indian Country - a loss of healthcare professionals, childcare services, and legal resources that will left our native American children and families behind. We are going to fight to protect them because they deserve the same resources and rights as any American would. 

https://t.co/jB4iOXTwbP

This week in @oversightdems, I highlighted what cuts in NIH funding would mean for loved ones who are waiting on life-saving treatment for ALS, for the young man in CA-12 who is on the brink of groundbreaking scientific discovery,  for our elders who have dementia. 

WATCH ⬇️ https://t.co/qW9i6QEbkS

Yesterday, I voted NO on the House Republican budget resolution. 

The Republican plan will roll back benefits from millions of Americans who rely on Medicaid, Medicare, & Social Security. 

CA-12, I won't stop fighting for our values or working on behalf of everyone.

Elon Musk and Donald Trump are trying to take Social Security benefits from seniors and Medicaid from children and families to give themselves and their friends tax breaks. 

Everyone deserves to have healthcare and the right to retire in dignity.

I was proud to join my Democratic colleagues in a letter calling on Speaker Johnson to reverse on any proposed cuts to Medicare, Medicaid, and Social Security, which millions of Americans rely in their daily life.

My office has received countless calls from  constituents expressing concern about the Republican continuing resolution.

I am voting NO because it guts many critical programs  Americans rely on.

It also provides no protections for Medicaid, Medicare, or Social Security from cuts.

Proud to have partners in the Senate @SenAlexPadilla and @SenAdamSchiff, who are strong fighters for Californians.

We are holding the line together in voting against the Republican CR funding bill. We need more support for disaster relief and cannot accept cuts to health care.

Today, the American people won in court.

Tens of thousands of federal employees, from researchers to VA health care workers, who were unjustly fired will be able to return to work. (1/2)

https://t.co/Yl7p005PU2

House Republicans are putting up the Senate budget resolution for a vote today.

This budget resolution proposes a minimum of $4 billion in cuts, including cuts that would decimate Medicaid.

This won’t stand – I am voting NO.

Thank you Ranking Member @GerryConnolly  for your decades of service and relentless advocacy for federal employees and the American people.

Thinking of you and sending my support to you and your family as you fight this diagnosis.

This week Republicans start to mark-up their budget plan.

This plan will make $4 trillion in cuts - including cuts to Medicaid, federal workers' retirement programs, Pell grants, Head Start, food assistance programs, & more.

Let's be clear-this plan benefits billionaires & hurts working families.

Trump's budget request is a clear sign he does not care for the people. 

Cuts to public health, education programs, climate programs, scientific research - while the richest among us get a tax break. 

It's unacceptable

https://t.co/a5K6HWLymX

🚨Republicans just failed to pass their own budget bill out of the Budget committee.

The Republican budget would have cut health care for millions, put nearly 11 million at risk of losing food assistance, cut clean energy tax credits.

I'll keep fighting in Congress to protect Medicaid and families.
